summary: Assess governance capability, clarify data ownership, and build practical improvement artefacts. Explore the advanced data governance course.
lede: Information governance training focuses on turning business and control needs into clear data-accountability practices. Designed for experienced data governance professionals, stewards, and consultants, it covers assessing capabilities with DCAM v3 and DAMA-DMBOK2R (2024), clarifying ownership and decision rights, and connecting metadata, data-quality rules, and lineage to operational controls. Exercises include building assessment evidence, a quality scorecard, a lineage impact review, and a prioritized improvement roadmap.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is designed for professionals who already work with data ownership, governance processes, metadata, or data-quality controls and need to coordinate improvements across business and technology teams.
prerequisites: Prior professional experience in data governance, data management, metadata, data quality, or a closely related function is expected. You should be familiar with data domains and cross-functional data processes. Coding or programming is not required. Advanced assessment and governance concepts are taught at operational application level; the course does not claim production implementation of metadata platforms.
